question: What productive benefit and relative advantage survive full copying of a calibration-aware allocation service?
independence: Fresh Writer 10 contribution; no Writer 6 manuscript, assumptions or outcomes used. Same-session delegated review is not external institutional peer review.

world.kind: explicit synthetic batch instrument; no physical experiment
world.utilityGeneration: four integer weights5 through15, seeded xorshift32 generator fixed in engine_adapter.mjs
world.truth: public synthetic generator; realized truth, bias, noise and failures withheld equally from all planners until execution
world.publicPlanningModel: exact calibration; constant bias within a batch; all current jobs available; no future job oracle
world.delayedQC: Four auxiliary reference acquisitions reveal the completed epoch relative-bias profile equally to every method. They are separately counted synthetic diagnostic units outside the four contested instrument ticks. They do not certify physical truth.
world.scope: Each method is a paired counterfactual operator of the same resource budget. Its output is not added to other methods as simultaneous social production.

conditions.capacity-doubled: Two samples per measurement tick; calibration still monopolizes its tick.
conditions.tight-validity: TTL=1 for every job; scope for calibration reuse disappears.
conditions.measurement-drift: Unobserved +0.8 bias at tick2 through tick3; same realized world for all policies. Perfect delayed QC available only to next epoch.
conditions.demand-drift: After six epochs, disclosed job weights become20 minus original generated weight.
conditions.reliability-failure: Each measurement tick fails with probability0.2; same realized failures across methods; failed work consumes resources.
conditions.cheap-calibration: Calibration takes zero contested ticks; its acquisition count remains charged. This strong substitute removes a bottleneck.
conditions.expensive-evidence: Eight complete inspections of same completion; useful output unchanged and inspection computation charged.

methods.idea-only: Executable conservative operationalization: optimal allocation with immediate prior calibration before each occupied measurement tick. Restriction-removal ablation, not strongest competitor.
methods.disclosed-implementation: Same complete shared-calibration planner; extra external receipt verification omitted. Useful output evaluated identically.
methods.verified-artifact: Pinned Alpha compiler/optimizer and completion inspection, with scoped execution/evidence records.
methods.full-clone: Byte-identical copied service executed afresh with current inputs and separate fixture identity; source-copy/startup time measured. Equality is expected existence witness, not independent reimplementation.
methods.exact-expert: Separately authored enumeration of2048 assignments using same public inputs and calibration rights; no Alpha compiler import.
methods.conventional-greedy: Simple value-first calibration-reuse policy with same job/capacity/validity rules.
methods.adaptive-expert: Independent enumeration uses last epoch delayed relative-bias profile; epoch0 stationary prior. All methods receive same past QC and may rebuild machinery.

objective.planned: Minimize100 times unserved predicted utility plus calibration count. Scale100 makes useful integer-weighted output lexicographically primary since at most3 calibrations.
objective.observed: Sum weights for attempted nonfailed synthetic measurements within absolute-error tolerance. Failed attempts/resources retained separately.
objective.primaryContrast: Ordinary verified-artifact minus idea-only mean true weighted output, paired by seed/epoch.
objective.practicalMargin: 5percent relative increase over idea-only in ordinary; descriptive paired bootstrap interval must exceed margin to describe practical evidence.
objective.copyContrast: Exact per-mission equality of plan/objective/true output after complete copying; report every discrepancy.
objective.expertContrast: True useful output and CPU cost against conventional, exact, adaptive comparators; no assumed superiority.

analysis.aggregation: Average12epochs within seed, then average32 paired seed clusters per condition/method.
analysis.uncertainty: 10000 paired cluster-bootstrap resamples, analysis RNG20261023, percentile95percent intervals; missions/jobs are not independent sample sizes.
analysis.multiplicity: One primary contrast; all stress, method and cost intervals descriptive. No familywise significance or permanent-moat claim.
analysis.time: All12epoch means and cumulative useful output; within-batch drift separately. Epochs are repeated short synthetic missions, not calendar-market time.
analysis.timing: CPU/monotonic wall, compile/solve/inspection work, source-copy/startup, bytes; method order rotates. Single-host timings are descriptive.
analysis.costs: Calibration/sample/diagnostic acquisitions, occupied ticks, CPU, bytes, local-EVM gas stay separate. Human research, model assistance, opportunity cost, real instrument/energy and demand unknown; actual customer revenue/live transactions zero.
analysis.sensitivity: Hypothetical resource/compute prices and break-even user value/producer margin; never label modeled revenue settled proceeds or full-cost profit.

failureRules: Retain every noncompletion/failure and original failed invocation.
No holdout tuning or resampling for desired conclusions.
Source repair after confirmation is dated deviation; old data/freeze stay intact.
Model-valid but truth-invalid receipt is a negative finding, not discarded.
Incomplete campaigns report counts and scope honestly.
registryCounterfactual: Same productive output bytes bound in local-EVM NovaSeed and off-chain signed registry. Service/evidence predicates compared; no equivalence claim for decentralized escrow or public consensus.
disclosureControls: Synthetic AES-256-GCM equal authorized access; wrong-key/ciphertext/AAD rejection; no persisted key. Public generator means workload secrecy unclaimed. Small-domain hash dictionary recovery.
publication: Unique edition; canonical PDF inside manifest-checked ZIP; existing coordinator retains shared-index/merge/Pages ownership and holds.
